summary: Full backend + frontend verification of student notifications (bell popover, red dot, mark-read, mark-all-read, selection_progress on admin status change, announcement fan-out, mobile responsive, admin scope isolation). All 6 pytest cases and all frontend acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1482 lines — still growing; strongly recommend splitting into feature modules (notifications, admin, site_content, auth) for maintainability.

notify_new_announcements deduplicates by (date|category|title|summary) signature — editing an existing announcement (e.g., correcting a typo) will re-notify all students. Consider adding a stable announcement id in the payload.
notify_new_announcements fans out to all registrations (up to 5000). For large audiences, replace insert_many blocking loop with a background task; also add insert_many(ordered=False) for resilience.

openNotification in StudentDashboard.jsx maps type -> tab via setActive; if new notification types are added later, unknown types silently fall back to 'status'. Add an explicit default (dashboard) or a mapping table.
HeaderNotifications shows only slice(0,5); there is no 'view all' / pagination — students with many notifications cannot access older ones.

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed announcements (via PUT /api/site/content) and status changes; all restored to original values after each test. One TEST_ANN_* notification remains in student inbox (no delete API exists) — considered harmless. Final student status left at 'lolos_administrasi' from frontend seeding; original was 'verifikasi'. If main agent needs pristine state, revert via admin PUT /api/admin/participants/{uid}/status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py covers: (1) GET /api/notifications shape + no Mongo _id, (2) PUT admin status → selection_progress notification created with target status label; identical status update is a no-op (no duplicate notif), (3) POST /notifications/{id}/read marks single, (4) 404 for wrong-user id, (5) POST /notifications/read-all is scope-isolated (admin unread untouched), (6) PUT /api/site/content with new announcement generates 'announcement' notification for registered students with correct title/message, then restored. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py -v -o addopts=''. Frontend verified: red dot appears iff unread_count>0, popover shows title+message+icon per type, click marks read + sets active tab to 'status' (announcement->'pengumuman'), mark-all-read clears both dot and unread text to 'Semua sudah dibaca'. Mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow with popover open (uses w-[min(22rem,calc(100vw-2rem))]). Admin header does NOT render HeaderNotifications or CandidateIdentity — confirmed absent.
